tools.name: record_condition
tools.description: Save an inspection report that describes existing damage to a museum object.
queries: While unpacking the bowl I noticed a hairline crack, add it to the object's file.
Where do I document the missing paint found during intake?
Save an inspection entry for the tear we just saw.

tools.name: request_treatment
tools.description: Open a proposal for stabilization or repair by a conservator.
queries: The frame is flaking and needs a conservator to work on it.
Can we start the paperwork to mend the broken mount?
Please send the damaged textile for stabilization.

tools.name: log_treatment
tools.description: Record repair or stabilization work already completed on an object.
queries: Note that the conservator finished reinforcing the binding yesterday.
Update the item file with the restoration that has just been done.
Attach the final notes for the stabilization work.

none: What would this painting fetch at auction?
Draft the audio guide narration for this exhibit.
Check next week's museum admission prices.

tools.name: set_pickup_delegate
tools.description: Authorize a different adult to collect a student from school.
queries: Can my sister collect Sam at dismissal today?
Our neighbor needs permission to take our child home.
Add the other parent as an approved pickup person.

tools.name: log_pickup
tools.description: Record that a student has actually been collected from the school.
queries: Jules already left with their guardian, enter that in the register.
Note that Dad collected them at 3:20.
Please sign out the child who just walked out with their aunt.

tools.name: change_bus_stop
tools.description: Update the boarding or drop-off location assigned to a student.
queries: The afternoon driver should drop Lou at Oak Street from now on.
Can we switch to the library stop instead of the corner?
Change where Nia boards the school bus.

none: Find the student's grades for science.
Notify the cafeteria that Mia needs a vegetarian lunch.
What time does the theater show start?

tools.name: check_colony_weight
tools.description: Read logged weight measurements from a hive scale.
queries: Did the hive get lighter since the last inspection?
Pull up Friday's reading for the box on the scale.
How much does the monitored colony weigh now?

tools.name: log_swarm
tools.description: Record the observation of a swarm leaving or gathering near a colony.
queries: A cluster took off from the hive this morning, write down the event.
Make a record of the bees massed on the branch next to the boxes.
I saw the colony swarm yesterday, capture that in the log.

tools.name: replace_queen
tools.description: Record a scheduled or completed introduction of a replacement queen to a colony.
queries: Add the new queen introduction to the hive notes.
The queen is failing and we're putting in a replacement, record that action.
Schedule the colony to be requeened after the old one is removed.

none: Find me a supplier for unpainted hive boxes.
What's the pollen count forecast in town?
Can you identify this insect from a photo?

tools.name: wind_bobbin
tools.description: Prepare a spool of lower thread for sewing.
queries: I ran out of thread underneath; fill another little spool.
How do I get a fresh supply of the underside thread ready?
Wind up more thread for the bottom of the machine.

tools.name: adjust_tension
tools.description: Change thread tension to correct loose or tight stitches.
queries: I'm getting loops on the underside of the seam, fix the thread pull.
The seam puckers because the upper thread pulls too hard.
Balance the top and bottom threads so the stitch knots sit in the fabric.

tools.name: change_needle
tools.description: Choose and install a different sewing machine needle.
queries: The point is bent, put in a fresh one.
Swap to the kind of needle that can go through this denim.
I think the old needle is causing skipped stitches; replace it.

none: Calculate the resale value of my sewing machine.
Remove the coffee stain from this shirt.
Send the pattern to a friend by email.
